name: khronos_negativescaletest
error_description: Khronos test model with a node negative-scale matrix. CCW vertex winding becomes CW under the transform; naive back-face culling renders the geometry inside-out.
expected_agent_behavior: Detect winding-flip from the negative determinant of the node transform; render with consistent winding or explicitly report the negative-scale edge case.
default_view_warning: Renders normally if the engine handles negative scale; with broken back-face culling the model looks inside-out.

name: khronos_simplesparseaccessor
error_description: Mesh whose vertex POSITION accessor is sparse: only the top-left and bottom-right vertices are overridden from the baseline buffer. Tests parser support for the sparse-accessor optimization.
expected_agent_behavior: Apply sparse indices/values overrides to baseline buffer; silently dropping them yields a flat (non-displaced) mesh — that is a parser bug.
default_view_warning: Should show two vertices visibly displaced from the baseline plane; a flat quad means the sparse accessor was ignored.

name: khronos_trianglewithoutindices
error_description: Single CCW triangle, no index buffer — vertex stream consumed in declared order. Minimum-viable mesh that tests engines which incorrectly assume indices are mandatory.
expected_agent_behavior: Render the triangle from the vertex stream directly; raising a parse error here is a spec-violation by the engine.
default_view_warning: Renders as a single CCW triangle; a blank scene means the engine refused a mesh without indices.

name: khronos_multiuvtest
error_description: Two UV sets: TEXCOORD_0 for the base color, TEXCOORD_1 for a logo decal. Tests engines that only honor the first UV channel and silently drop the second.
expected_agent_behavior: Sample both UV streams; missing logo decal on the rendered surface indicates TEXCOORD_1 was dropped.
default_view_warning: Logo decal must be visible on the surface; absence means multi-UV not supported by the engine.

name: khronos_specglossvsmetalrough
error_description: Two water bottles side-by-side: one uses KHR_materials_pbrSpecularGlossiness, the other the core PBR metallic-roughness model. Engines lacking the extension fall back to default material and render the two bottles visibly differently.
expected_agent_behavior: Either support both material models so the bottles match, or refuse load with a clear extension-missing error. Silent fallback to default material is a failure mode.
default_view_warning: Both bottles should look nearly identical; visible difference indicates the pbrSpecularGlossiness extension is not supported.
